summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a ratings report from S&P Global Ratings Maalot Ltd. regarding the issuance of unsecured Series G notes of up to NIS 1 billion P.V. The report assigns an ilA rating with a stable outlook. Proceeds will be used for ongoing activity and refinancing existing debt. No special-situation event—merger, acquisition, spin-off, tender, restructuring—is present. This is a routine debt-rating update, equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K for a U.S. issuer.
